tokenHandling.hyphenatedCompounds: Skipped as one ineligible token; no partial compound gap is created.
tokenHandling.apostrophes: Tokens containing straight or typographic apostrophes are skipped as ineligible.
tokenHandling.punctuation: Kept outside the input and excluded from the completion.

deterministicValidation: Structural validation verifies corpus counts, stable IDs and gap construction; it is not native-speaker validation.
